prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1458; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported in Katy, Texas. Please state and spell your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the facts of what happened, but I'm happy to say I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: Understood. Can you describe how the collision occurred?

A: I was driving on a two-lane road heading toward a shopping center. The other car came over into my lane while it was going slowly, and we met almost head-on. It wasn't a hard hit. Both cars were moving at low speed, maybe a few miles an hour when they connected.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was belted in, and the airbags did not go off.

Q: Did you feel any injuries immediately after the collision?

A: Not right away. About an hour later my neck got stiff and my lower back started aching. By the next morning it was harder to turn my head to check mirrors, and sitting for long periods bothered me.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening I noticed the symptoms. They diagnosed neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and some referral for physical therapy. I have an appointment set up for next week.

Q: Did you call the police or exchange information with the other driver?

A: An officer came out and wrote a report. We exchanged insurance details at the scene.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add before we conclude?

A: Only that I want to get my neck and back properly checked out, and I'm cooperating fully with whatever you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
